messages.content: Help me generate the XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields?

function.name: RootObjectMapper_doXContent
function.description: Serializes the RootObjectMapper settings to XContent, with options to include default values and to skip runtime fields. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

builder.description: The XContentBuilder to which the content should be written. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

params.description: Parameters controlling the serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. This is Java ArrayList type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type any; they are not in string representation.

message.reasoning:
The user wants help generating XContent with xContentBuilderInstance for a RootObjectMapper that includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection, while skipping runtime fields.

We need to call the function RootObjectMapper_doXContent with builder and params. The builder is an instance of XContentBuilder. The params is an ArrayList of parameters controlling serialization, including whether to include defaults and whether to skip runtime fields. We need to include default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection. So we need to set includeDefaults=true and skipRuntimeFields=true. Also we might need to set other flags like includeDynamicTemplates? But the function signature only has builder and params. The params is an ArrayList of parameters controlling serialization. We need to pass a list containing includeDefaults=true and skipRuntimeFields=true. Possibly also includeDynamicTemplates? But the question says "includes default settings for dynamic date formats, dynamic templates, date detection, and numeric detection". That likely means we want to include defaults for those settings. So we need to set includeDefaults=true. The dynamic templates, date detection, numeric detection are part of the mapping. If we set includeDefaults=true, it will include defaults for those. So we just need to set includeDefaults=true and skipRuntimeFields=true.

Thus we need to call the function with builder: xContentBuilderInstance, params: [includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true]. The params is an ArrayList of parameters controlling serialization. So we need to create an ArrayList with two elements: includeDefaults=true and skipRuntimeFields=true. In Java, that would be something like new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true)). But we need to represent it as a string. So we can provide something like "[includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true]".

Thus the function call:

{
  "builder": "xContentBuilderInstance",
  "params": "[includeDefaults=true, skipRuntimeFields=true]"
}
